prompt:
Subject: catalog, target meaning "カタログ".

Composition: A shopper browses an open product catalog whose pages contain neat pictures of chairs, lamps, and tables in ordered rows, with no readable names or prices.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png: rounded friendly 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading.
en: The catalog shows an ordered collection of furniture and lamps.
ja: カタログには家具や照明器具が整理して掲載されています。
